headline: Westmont win at Vanguard and host Hawai'i Pacific next
dek: Hawai'i Pacific won at Dominican (Calif.) the same day and have not lost since Westmont beat them on their own ground in October. Vanguard, level with Hawai'i Pacific on points at the top of the table, were beaten at home.
displaced_by: Both of the matches the old dek said were still to come have now been played: Westmont won at Vanguard and Hawai'i Pacific won at Dominican (Calif.), which sets up Westmont v Hawai'i Pacific.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Kyle Denn has scored fourteen of Biola's twenty-eight goals, exactly half of everything his side has scored.
